name: Library volunteering and VolunTEEN
org: Prince George's County Memorial Library System
what_you_do: Help at a branch as a library, computer, facility or program aide, or earn up to 6 service hours through VolunTEEN. Teens over the age of 15 can help in the Kids Achieve Club homework program.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 14 (library system rule). VolunTEEN is for grades 6 to 12. The Kids Achieve Club welcomes teens over 15. Volunteers cannot staff the Circulation or Information desks.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Student service learning hours are available.
duration: Temporary (limited) or regular (at least 6 months) schedules
deadline_text: No deadline. Kids Achieve Club interviews: June for September programs, November for January programs.
how_to_apply: Get a volunteer application from your local branch and ask for the volunteer coordinator. For VolunTEEN, sign up through the Beanstack app.
notes: The page says volunteers must be vaccinated and that the library is accepting volunteers; check with your branch for the current rule. Unpaid volunteering, so no work permit.
